max_wal_senders.describe: Maximum number of simultaneous WAL sender processes. Must be less than max_connections.

autovacuum_max_workers.describe: Maximum number of autovacuum worker processes that may be running at any one time.

max_connections.describe: Maximum number of concurrent connections to the database server.

wal_buffers.describe: Amount of shared memory used for WAL data that has not yet been written to disk. Min is auto, Max is 1GB

shared_buffers.describe: Amount of memory the database server uses for shared memory buffers.

autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor.describe: Fraction of table size before an ANALYZE is triggered by autovacuum.

autovacuum_analyze_threshold.describe: Minimum number of inserted, updated, or deleted tuples needed to trigger an ANALYZE in autovacuum.

autovacuum_naptime.describe: Minimum delay between autovacuum runs on any given database.

autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay.describe: Cost delay value that will be used in automatic VACUUM operations.

autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit.describe: Cost limit value that will be used in automatic VACUUM operations.

autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor.describe: Fraction of table size before a VACUUM is triggered by autovacuum.

autovacuum_vacuum_threshold.describe: Minimum number of updated or deleted tuples needed to trigger a VACUUM in autovacuum.

backend_flush_after.describe: Number of pages after which previously performed writes by a single backend are flushed to disk.

bgwriter_delay.describe: Delay between activity rounds for the background writer.

bgwriter_flush_after.describe: Number of pages after which previously performed writes by the background writer are flushed to disk.

bgwriter_lru_maxpages.describe: Maximum number of LRU pages the background writer can write to disk per round.

bgwriter_lru_multiplier.describe: Multiplier used to estimate the number of buffers that will be needed by the background writer.

checkpoint_completion_target.describe: Target of checkpoint completion, as a fraction of total time between checkpoints.

checkpoint_flush_after.describe: Number of pages after which previously performed writes by the checkpointer are flushed to disk.

checkpoint_timeout.describe: Maximum time between automatic WAL checkpoints.

commit_delay.describe: Time delay to wait before writing a commit record to disk.

commit_siblings.describe: Minimum number of concurrent open transactions required for commit_delay to take effect.

cursor_tuple_fraction.describe: Planner's estimate of the fraction of a cursor's rows that will be retrieved.

deadlock_timeout.describe: Amount of time to wait on a lock before checking for deadlock.

default_statistics_target.describe: Default statistics target for table columns.

effective_cache_size.describe: Planner's estimate of the effective size of the disk cache that is available to a single query.

effective_io_concurrency.describe: Number of concurrent disk I/O operations that PostgreSQL expects can be executed simultaneously.

from_collapse_limit.describe: If the resulting FROM list would have no more than this many items, subqueries are collapsed into their parent.

geqo_effort.describe: Controls the trade-off between planning time and query plan quality in GEQO.

geqo_generations.describe: Number of generations used by GEQO algorithm.

geqo_pool_size.describe: Pool size used by GEQO algorithm.

geqo_seed.describe: Initial value of the random number generator used by GEQO to select random paths through the query search space.

geqo_threshold.describe: Use genetic query optimization to plan queries with at least this many FROM items.

join_collapse_limit.describe: Planner will rewrite explicit JOIN constructs into lists of FROM items if the list will have no more than this many items.

maintenance_work_mem.describe: Maximum amount of memory to be used by maintenance operations, such as VACUUM, CREATE INDEX, and ALTER TABLE ADD FOREIGN KEY.

temp_buffers.describe: Maximum number of temporary buffers used by each database session.

temp_file_limit.describe: Maximum disk space used for temporary files per session, in kilobytes.

vacuum_cost_delay.describe: Time cost delay that will be used in VACUUM operations.

vacuum_cost_limit.describe: Accumulated cost that will cause the vacuuming process to sleep.

vacuum_cost_page_dirty.describe: Estimated cost to vacuum a page that was dirty beforehand.

vacuum_cost_page_hit.describe: Estimated cost to vacuum a page found in the shared buffer cache.

vacuum_cost_page_miss.describe: Estimated cost to vacuum a page that has to be read from disk.

wal_writer_delay.describe: Delay between activity rounds for the WAL writer.

work_mem.describe: Maximum amount of memory to be used by internal sort operations and hash tables before writing to temporary disk files.
